name: ASM
recent: ASM 于 2026 年 8 月 28 日召开第二届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过；同日发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度报告。公司于 2026 年 10 月 28 日公告更改财政年度结束日。
notable: 第二届常年股东大会于 2026 年 8 月 28 日举行，所有决议均以投票方式通过。
公司公告更改财政年度结束日。

recent_en: ASM held its 2nd AGM on 28 Aug 2026, with all resolutions passed, and released its quarterly report for the period ended 30 Jun 2026 on the same day. The company announced a change in financial year end on 28 Oct 2026.
notable_en: The 2nd AGM was held on 28 Aug 2026 and all resolutions were passed by poll.
The company announced a change in its financial year end.
